notable_absence.finding: This page has no equivalent of Slack's Bot Token connection method or its associated scopes - Microsoft Teams supports exactly one connection method (Webhook URL from the Workflows app), and the edit restriction is stated explicitly: 'You cannot edit your Webhook URL details. To change your Webhook URL, you must delete your existing alert integration and create a new one.' No notable absence beyond that; this page is otherwise a clean structural parallel of configure-slack-integration.md and configure-webhook-integration.md.

cross_component_finding: Prerequisites (roles, Enterprise/Developer Pro Support Plan gate, 3-address firewall allowlist, up to 5 integrations per project) are verbatim-identical to configure-slack-integration.md and configure-webhook-integration.md - the shared-shell side of this batch's hypothesis confirmed a third time. The per-tool difference here is payload format only (Adaptive Cards, per microsoft-reference.md) plus the single-connection-method simplicity already noted as an absence relative to Slack.
